target_head_commit: HEAD (Milestone M2: POC-1 USB Hub Spec QA Agent)

findings.description: 30 題 Golden Dataset 完整覆蓋 Direct 基礎查詢 (10 題)、Version Confusion 跨版本混淆 (10 題)、Unsupported Refusal 範圍外拒答 (5 題) 與 Adversarial 惡意對抗陷阱 (5 題)。每一題均嚴格定義 accepted_evidence_ids 與 expected_behavior，具備完全確定性之驗收標準。
五層確定性評測器 (Existence, Membership, Support, Answer, Boundary) 嚴格落實 Fabricated Citations = 0 與 Authority Violations = 0 之硬門檻；針對未登錄 Evidence 或試圖提升 Informative 為 Normative 之行為均能精確攔截判定。
部署架構清晰定義 Repo B (VitePress) 與 Repo A (Backend) 間的隔離界線，採用 Same-Origin Proxy 架構轉發 /api/qa，嚴格禁止 Public JS Bundle 攜帶內部模型端點 IP 或 API Key，落實 Zero-Trust 邊界防護。
GovernedSpecRetriever 顯式鎖定 knowledge_repo 與 knowledge_repo_commit (7a8b9c0d...)，每筆 Evidence 均帶有 authority_level、scope 與 claim_level 等元數據，杜絕知識庫漂移。

non_claims: Advisory approval of M2 Spec QA Agent does not imply that the backend model gateway is publicly hardened against arbitrary DoS/DDoS attacks without upstream WAF/Rate Limiting.
Passing deterministic unit & golden contract tests does not waive human domain reviewer validation on future knowledge repository updates.
Zero fabricated citation guarantee is strictly bounded to the evaluation surface defined in dataset_30.json and registered evidence entries.
